synthetic_outcome_semantics.material: set the SOFT edge relevant_fields to the changed event fields
synthetic_outcome_semantics.non_material: set the SOFT edge relevant_fields to a distinct, non-overlapping field

field_aware_dag: independent traversal baseline using the same edge field metadata and synthetic review outcomes; assumes valid fixtures and omits GAMO-CA's validation/provenance features
timing_scope: planner calls only; excludes synthetic human review time and asset generation
